name: prompt-bar

frames.best_why: The composer holds a typed @Sales data mention with the send arrow armed and every control visible.

tagline: A chat composer with @ sources, model and effort pickers and a send arrow.
summary: A rounded chat input with a placeholder, an @ menu for sources and slash commands, model and effort selectors, a dictation mic and a send button that morphs to stop while busy.
appearance: A rounded dark bar with a multiline text area above a row of small controls: a plus button, a model dropdown, a sparkled effort label, a microphone and a filled circular send arrow at the right. Small chips and chat bubbles sit in the space above.
behaviour: Typing @ or / opens a floating list of sources or commands that filters as you type and can be picked with the arrow keys and Enter. Enter sends the message, and while waiting the send arrow morphs into a stop square.
demo_content: Finance chat: asking how September closed versus August, with a reply about $1.42M revenue and 2.1% churn.
search_phrases: chat text box with slash commands
use_when: An AI assistant needs a compact composer with references, model choice and voice in one bar.
avoid_when: It is dense with small icon controls and hardcoded dark colours, so it looks cramped on narrow screens.
customise: Placeholder, sources, commands, models, efforts, defaults, callbacks, busy state, colours, width, radius, row cap and morph, squash, tilt and press settings are props.
weight_why: DOM controls with CSS transitions; a small canvas particle loop runs only at maximum effort.

a11y.note: Controls and menus have labels and keyboard support, but focus rings are suppressed, so keyboard focus is hard to see.

issues: The @ source menu floats over the chat transcript above the bar and hides part of the last reply.
polish_why: Dense but tidy composer with clear controls; the source menu overlaps the chat above it.
